sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, long and narrow: head length including mandibles 2.13, length without mandibles 1.53, head width 0.80, mandible length 0.72—0.75 mm. Closest to Microcerotermes hamatus. Type locality Macaco (Luebo), Belgian Congo, collected by Schouteden, the type specimens in the Tervuren and Stockholm museums.

note: Adapted from the original description by Sjöstedt (1925), original in German; it is a brief diagnostic description of the soldier (vorläufige Mitteilung) and describes the soldier only.
